title: One Word Opens the Gate: The Option-Channel Attack on Typed Decision Models as Agent Guardrails
abstract: arXiv:2610.12292v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A typed decision model reads a piece of text and returns a probability over caller-defined options, each with a short written definition, generating no text. Recent work places these models in agent systems as guardrails: the component that reads a proposed tool call or incoming message and decides whether to allow it. We evaluate seven open-weight models in that role and report the two error directions separately: a fail-open error allows a prohibited action and is a vulnerability; a fail-closed error blocks a permitted one and is only a cost. On prompt-injection, jailbreak and toxic-content screening, accuracy at the allow-or-block decision ranges from 36% to 72% against a chance level of 50%. A low error rate in one direction only reflects which answer a model defaults to: one allows nearly everything, another blocks nearly everything. translated_title: 一个词就能打开大门：针对作为智能体防护栏的类型化决策模型的选项通道攻击
translated_abstract: 类型化决策模型读取一段文本，并返回一个在调用者定义的选项上的概率分布，每个选项都附带简短的书面定义，且模型本身不生成任何文本。近期的工作将这类模型部署到智能体系统中作为防护栏：即读取提议的工具调用或传入消息、并决定是否放行的组件。我们评估了七个开源权重模型在该角色下的表现，并分别报告了两个错误方向：故障开放错误会放行被禁止的操作，属于安全漏洞；故障关闭错误会拦截被允许的操作，仅带来成本损失。在提示注入、越狱和有害内容筛查任务上，允许/拦截决策的准确率在36%到72%之间，而随机猜测水平为50%。某一方向上的低错误率仅反映了模型默认给出的答案：一个模型几乎放行所有内容，另一个则几乎拦截所有内容。在一个智能体工具调用的合成测试套件上，六行与……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 类型化决策模型作为智能体防护栏时准确率仅为36%–72%（随机水平为50%），攻击者可通过“选项通道”仅用一个词即可打开大门突破防护，而单向低错误率只反映模型的默认倾向，并非真正的安全性。
en_tdlr: Typed decision models serving as agent guardrails achieve only 36%–72% accuracy (versus a 50% chance level), and the option-channel attack shows that a single word can open the gate, with one-directional low error rates merely reflecting a model's default behavior rather than genuine security.
